media.title: Marek Weber — photograph by Jacob Merkelbach, 1934
media.description: Studio portrait of the violinist and bandleader Marek Weber, photographed by Jacob Merkelbach in 1934.
media.altText: Black-and-white studio portrait of Marek Weber in a suit.
media.publicCaption: Marek Weber, photographed by Jacob Merkelbach in 1934. His orchestra recorded several of Kaper’s songs for Electrola and His Master’s Voice.
media.publicCreditLine: Jacob Merkelbach (1877–1942); Beeldbank, Stadsarchief Amsterdam, via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the European Union: the photographer Jacob Merkelbach died in 1942, so the term of life and seventy years expired in 2013, and Wikimedia Commons records the file as free of known restrictions. The United States position is not settled here: if the photograph was published in 1934, its Dutch term was still running on 1 January 1996 and the URAA would have restored United States copyright. A reduced-resolution reproduction (500 × 674 px, from 2124 × 2862 px) is used for scholarly identification of a documented performer of Kaper’s songs.
